name: ImageDrawImage
description: this function is deprecated, use ImagePaste instead. Draws a image on a image with the baseline of the first character positioned at (x,y) in the image.
syntax: ImageDrawImage( any image, any image, number x, number y )

params.name: x
params.description: The x coordinate of the of the top left corner of the image to draw.

params.name: y
params.description: The y coordinate of the of the top left corner of the image to draw.
